$comment: THE SOURCE CENSUS DECLARATION -- the `source:` provider of `check-doc-census`.
★★★ THE PATTERN LIVES HERE, NEVER IN THE COMMENT IT CHECKS. A figure written in a
source comment is a measurement with NO INSTRUMENT ATTACHED: the reader cannot
re-derive it and no guard can check it, so it decays silently in the direction of
looking authoritative -- which is what
D-TEST-CMAKE-COMMENT-QUOTES-A-CORPUS-COUNT-THE-TEST-IT-REGISTERS-FORBIDS says.
The obvious repair -- write the grep next to the number -- fails for the same
reason the number does: a pattern quoted in prose is prose. So the pattern is DATA,
here, keyed by the census key the comment's marker names, and the comment carries
only the marker and the figure. Re-deriving is then a command anyone can run, and
`ctest` runs it on every gate.
★ EVERY KEY DECLARES `files` (repo-relative glob patterns, `**` recursive) and
`matchingLines` (a Python regex). The value is the number of LINES matching that
regex across the de-duplicated union of the matched files. `$comment` is free text
and is ignored.
⚠ A `files` pattern that matches NOTHING is a REFUSAL, never a zero. A glob that
silently stops matching -- a directory renamed, a file moved -- would otherwise
report 0 and any comment that had rotted to 0 would agree with it. That is the
fails-toward-clean direction this project refuses in a guard.
Concrete `MirRebuildPolicy` subclasses -- the per-pass policies that drive the
one shared MIR rebuild substrate. Bound by the header's comment, which uses the
count to argue that a rebuilder fatal unable to name its pass is unattributable.
★ It is counted here because on 2026-09-07 TWO comments stated it (the header's
and the .cpp's), both said `~9`, and both had drifted two below the truth. The
.cpp's copy was replaced by the universal claim it was always making, so the
number now has ONE owner and that owner is checked.
The base class itself declares no inheritance, so it cannot match.
Exported declarations in `compile_pipeline.hpp` -- the header's own map of what
it publishes, used there to argue which entry points a driver can reach.
★★ THIS KEY EXISTS BECAUSE THAT COMMENT BLOCK IS THE WORKED EXAMPLE OF THE WHOLE
DEFECT. It is a paragraph-long meditation on going stale: its author noticed the
FIRST spelling of this instrument counted the very comment that quoted it, moved
the pattern to a line anchor so no prose could pollute it, and wrote down why.
The re-anchored instrument then went stale by SIX anyway, unnoticed, across at
least four cycles -- because nothing machine-checked it. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-07:
the block carried SEVEN false figures at once. Care did not fix it and care will
not fix it; only a comparison run by ctest does.
⚠ TWO OF THE SEVEN ARE STILL NOT BOUND, deliberately and not by oversight:
"13 of the 18 entry points" is a DISTINCT count (call sites over entry points
reached), and "3.6%" is a RATIO. A CLAIM binds an integer, so neither is
expressible here. They were corrected by hand and remain unguarded -- stated so
the next reader does not mistake the marked figures' green for whole-block
coverage.
The exported STRUCTS alone. Split from the total because the header states both,
and a single figure cannot catch a struct becoming a function or the reverse --
the two must sum to `program.exportedDecls` and each is checked on its own.
The exported FUNCTIONS alone -- every exported declaration line that does not
open with `struct`. Together with `program.exportedStructs` this partitions
`program.exportedDecls`, so a drift in either half is caught even when the total
happens not to move.
CALL sites of `linkAndWriteWithStaticArchives` in the driver -- each one a
separate argument list a later edit can change on its own, which is the header's
whole argument for classifying per ROUTE rather than per entry point.
★ MATCHED ON THE CALL FORM, NEVER THE BARE NAME. `program.cpp` mentions this
function five times in PROSE; a name-only count returns nine and the header's own
text warns about exactly that over-count for a sibling symbol. ✔MEASURED
2026-09-07: the comment said THREE routes and there are four -- the fourth is a
real call site the prose never absorbed.
